draft_text: On the Brindle-Voice test set, Brisling decodes faster than Talmar, with a median latency of 41 vs 118 ms per utterance.
revised_text: On the Brindle-Voice test set, Brisling's median latency is 41 ms per utterance (Corvex A2, fp16) versus 118 ms for Talmar (Corvex A1, fp32, from Ruiz-Hale et al., 2023).
rationale: T1.r1.lat=41 (Corvex A2, fp16) and T1.r2.lat=118 (Corvex A1, fp32). The claim states the numbers and the comparison. However, latencies were measured on different accelerators/precisions, so "decodes faster" is a direct comparison of incomparable measurements. The claim reports the numbers accurately but the causal "faster" overstates comparability.
